d: China's alleged espionage and influence operations are raising fresh national security concerns in the United States. From targeting influential executives like Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang to exploiting personal relationships, business networks and lobbying channels, Beijing's intelligence playbook may extend far beyond traditional spying. But how does China's Ministry of State Security operate? Peter Mattis, President of The Jamestown Foundation and former CIA counterintelligence analyst, joins Griha Atul on Firstpost Spotlight to decode China's espionage tactics, the Nvidia controversy and…
